metadata.label: scenario estimate, not validated
metadata.purpose: State-level India location inputs (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana) for the unit-economics comparison, in that thread's location shape
common_caveats: Wages are legal minimum plus a burden proxy, not market wages
Paid hours per day are 8 in every state; sourced only for Telangana (overtime beyond 8 h)
Electricity is energy charge only; fixed/demand charges, duty and fuel surcharges are excluded
Which tariff category an aquaponic unit falls into is unknown in every state, so low = agri/horticulture-type category, high = commercial-type category
No state-specific basil price exists; all four share the all-India band
Karnataka has a second price reference from B2B listings (Rs 65-180/kg) that conflicts sharply with the all-India band; see basil_price_b2b_listings_per_kg

wage_per_hour.source: WageIndicator compilation of Karnataka agriculture and related works minimum wage, Rs 533.21/day (basic 401.26 + VDA 131.95), valid 1 Apr 2025 to 31 Mar 2026; 8 h/day per a 2024-25 compilation (echoforum PDF, unverified)
wage_per_hour.confidence_reason: Secondary compiler, period has expired, newer revision not confirmed; 8 h/day unverified
wage_per_hour.derivation: Minimum wage x 1.1525 statutory-burden proxy (research pack, EPF/ESI), divided by paid hours per day

electricity_per_kwh.source: Low: LT-4c private horticultural nurseries Rs 3.45/kWh (electricbill.in aggregator). High: LT-3a commercial Rs 7.10/kWh (KERC review order, PTI via ThePrint, 4 Mar 2026)
electricity_per_kwh.confidence_reason: No primary KERC order read; aggregator and news values conflict for LT-3a and LT-5; aquaponics tariff category unknown
electricity_per_kwh.excluded: fixed charges (about Rs 165-235 per kW or HP per month)

eur_per_currency_unit_for_comparison.source: ECB reference rate 20 April 2026, EUR 1 = INR 109.4525, comparison only
eur_per_currency_unit_for_comparison.confidence_reason: official reference rate; comparison only, not for canon

basil_wholesale_price_per_kg.source: 2025 Andhra Pradesh hydroponic basil study (Rs 1,000/kg sale price) with operator haircuts to 600
basil_wholesale_price_per_kg.confidence_reason: No state-specific basil wholesale price found; same all-India band used for every state; the study price is not first-wholesale
basil_wholesale_price_per_kg.note: Same band in all four states

basil_price_b2b_listings_per_kg.source: IndiaMART Bengaluru fresh Italian/sweet basil listings (m.indiamart.com/city/bengaluru/ocimum-basilicum.html and impcat/ocimum-basilicum.html), page dated 25 Nov 2026, read 2026-11-25; seeds, dried, tulsi, oil and plants excluded
basil_price_b2b_listings_per_kg.confidence_reason: Seller asking prices on a B2B directory, marked approximate; not transaction prices; market level (farm-gate vs wholesale vs distributor) not stated; but 10 independent Bengaluru sellers, including 3 hydroponic growers at Rs 65-130, agree on order of magnitude
basil_price_b2b_listings_per_kg.conflict: 5x to 15x below the all-India band (Rs 600-1,000) whose only anchor is one 2025 Andhra hydroponic study. Treat as a context split to resolve, not an overwrite. Other cities on the same pages: Ahmedabad 200, Neemuch 150, Indore 90.
basil_price_b2b_listings_per_kg.status: candidate, awaiting Ajit's review; not used as the default band

basil_price_ajit_local_knowledge_per_kg.source: Ajit, thread message 2026-11-25: Bangalore basil runs Rs 100 to 250/kg depending on processed, fresh or organic
basil_price_ajit_local_knowledge_per_kg.confidence_reason: First-hand local knowledge that agrees with 10 IndiaMART Bengaluru listings (Rs 65-180); grade standards and market level (farm-gate vs wholesale vs retail) not defined
basil_price_ajit_local_knowledge_per_kg.grade_note: Ajit says the top of the range depends on processing, fresh vs not, and organic; no formal grade standard identified
basil_price_ajit_local_knowledge_per_kg.status: user_supplied; treat as the Karnataka price band in place of the Rs 600-1,000 study band

wage_per_hour.source: No Tamil Nadu state agriculture minimum wage found. Proxy: central-sphere agriculture minimum wage incl. VDA w.e.f. 1 Oct 2026 (Labour Bureau order 6/1/2026-VDA, via govtstaff.com), unskilled Area C Rs 486 to skilled Area A Rs 637/day
wage_per_hour.confidence_reason: Central-sphere rates bind only central-government establishments, used as proxy; paid hours/day (8) not sourced
wage_per_hour.derivation: Minimum wage x 1.1525 statutory-burden proxy (research pack, EPF/ESI), divided by paid hours per day

electricity_per_kwh.source: TNERC T.O. No.6 of 2025 (from 1 Jul 2025) per thediscombill.com: low LT-IIIA(1) cottage/micro incl. poultry and dairy up to 12 kW, 0-250 units Rs 4.95 (above 250: 7.15); high LT-V commercial above 50 units Rs 10.45. Consistent with official T.O. No.6 of 2024 (4.80 / 10.15)
electricity_per_kwh.confidence_reason: Secondary site, but matches the pattern of the official 2024 order; agriculture LT-IV FY2025-26 not found; category for aquaponics unknown
electricity_per_kwh.excluded: fixed charges Rs 77-110 per kW per month

electricity_per_kwh.source: APERC RSTO FY2025-26 (tariffs kept unchanged): V-B aquaculture and animal husbandry Rs 3.85; V-A(vi) floriculture in greenhouse Rs 4.50 (from an unverified extract of a RESCO copy). APERC highlights confirm horticultural nurseries get free power (GO 39) and aquaculture a Rs 1.50/unit concession (GO 70)
electricity_per_kwh.confidence_reason: Tariff table not read verbatim; commercial fallback not found so the high end may be too low; eligibility of an aquaponic unit for agri or aquaculture categories unknown
electricity_per_kwh.excluded: fixed charges Rs 30-75 per month (unit unconfirmed); concessions not applied

wage_per_hour.source: Telangana G.O.Ms.No.6, 30 May 2026, from 1 Jun 2026 (Code on Wages; agriculture listed in Schedule II): unskilled Zone III Rs 14,000/month to skilled Zone I Rs 18,500/month, divided by 26 days per the GO = Rs 538.46 to 711.54/day; overtime beyond 8 h
wage_per_hour.confidence_reason: Current state GO covering agriculture, read in full; hosted by a consultancy not the gazette; burden factor is a proxy
wage_per_hour.derivation: Minimum wage x 1.1525 statutory-burden proxy (research pack, EPF/ESI), divided by paid hours per day

electricity_per_kwh.source: TGSPDCL Retail Supply Tariff Schedule FY2025-26 (1 May 2025 to 31 Mar 2026): low LT-V(B) horticulture nurseries / LT-IV(B) agro-based activities Rs 4.00; high LT-II(B) non-domestic above 50 units Rs 8.50. Pisciculture LT-III Rs 6.20
electricity_per_kwh.confidence_reason: Official discom schedule read directly, but its period has expired and no newer one was found; aquaponics category unknown
electricity_per_kwh.excluded: fixed charges Rs 20-70 per kW or HP per month
